items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public beta or go-live; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not public/commercial redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict relevant uses. Compliance is technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow, operations and security sweeps are unavailable, and Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and not site-attributable. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task closes because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete an internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. The concrete next evidence action is a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and an explicit blocker. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, or add dependencies before those gates are evidenced.
